title: Airblue Expands Domestic Network With Two New Routes
excerpt: Airline launches direct flights connecting Quetta with Islamabad and Lahore, offering five weekly flights.
body_html:
Airline carrier Airblue has expanded its domestic route network by introducing direct flights to Quetta from both Islamabad and Lahore.

The new flight operations began on October 26, according to the airline's latest schedule updates. With this launch, the carrier is offering a total of five weekly flights to support the newly added routes and improve domestic connectivity between these cities.
